title: 8 ranchers. 1 petition. A national monument #Shorts
description:
In 1908 eight ranchers from southern Utah asked for a land survey of Zion Canyon. On July 31, 1909, President Taft signed the proclamation creating Mukuntuweap National Monument.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 3: The Impossible Tunnel): https://youtu.be/30zzYRt_Mgk
